title: Per-Role End-to-End Process Flows
note: Each role's complete workflow as a mermaid flowchart. Patient → … → audit. Default flow for roles without a specific one.

default.mermaid:
graph LR
  A[Receive case]-->B[Review inputs]
  B-->C[AI analysis]
  C-->D[Validate]
  D-->E[Decision]
  E-->F[Sign-off + audit]

Neurologist.mermaid:
graph LR
  A[Patient referral]-->B[Load EEG + history]
  B-->C[AI seizure analysis]
  C-->D[Explainability SHAP]
  D-->E[Biomarkers + localization]
  E-->F[MRI/EEG concordance]
  F-->G{Human validate}
  G-->|agree|H[Final impression]
  G-->|override|H
  H-->I[Sign-off + audit]

EEG Technician.mermaid:
graph LR
  A[Prep + consent]-->B[10-20 placement]
  B-->C[Impedance check]
  C-->D[Record + activation]
  D-->E[Event + artifact annotation]
  E-->F{Signal QC}
  F-->|pass|G[Export EDF + report]
  F-->|fail|D
  G-->H[Hand-off]

Clinical Neurophysiologist.mermaid:
graph LR
  A[Receive study]-->B[Background rhythm]
  B-->C[Epileptiform review]
  C-->D[Localization]
  D-->E[Seizure review]
  E-->F[Artifact review]
  F-->G[AI label validation]
  G-->H[Interpretation report]
  H-->I[Deliver labels]

Patient.mermaid:
graph LR
  A[Onboarding]-->B[Seizure diary]
  B-->C[Track triggers/sleep/meds]
  C-->D[Wearable sync]
  D-->E[Risk + reports]
  E-->F[Telehealth]
  F-->G[Follow-up]

AI Governance.mermaid:
graph LR
  A[Model registration]-->B[Data governance]
  B-->C[Explainability]
  C-->D[Fairness scan]
  D-->E{Human oversight}
  E-->F[Clinical validation]
  F-->G[Risk review]
  G-->H{Approve?}
  H-->|yes|I[Deploy + monitor]
  H-->|no|A

Pharmacist.mermaid:
graph LR
  A[Med review]-->B[Adherence]
  B-->C[Interaction scan]
  C-->D[TDM levels]
  D-->E[Side effects]
  E-->F[Recommendation]
  F-->G[Counsel]
  G-->H[Document]
